Subject: Listing LatticeAI composite on marketplace + private offer routing questions

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving fast on a combined offering (LatticeAI runtime + managed connector) and want to list as a Private Offer on the major clouds so enterprise customers can buy through procurement with co-sell credits. A few quick questions we hope Redwood can help with: 

1) Private offer routing: when a customer purchases a private offer, can Redwood route metering & co-sell signals back to us (and to Redwood's co-sell org) so the sale shows up for partner credits?
2) Cross-account billing: our connector will span two billing entities (LatticeAI and our reseller). Any docs you can share about recommended skus/entitlements?
3) Evidence pack: procurement is asking for SOC2 and a short technical runbook for VPC peering and KMS location. Can we get an itemized evidence checklist you need from us so Redwood can attach to the marketplace listing?

We tried the public listing flow but think Private Offer + co-sell will be the right path for our first three customers. If easier, we can hop on a 30-min call.

Best,
Anita Shah
VP, Partnerships — LatticeAI

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can propagate co-sell signals for private offers (we surface them back to partners and to our GTM via the co-sell tag), and we support cross-account entitlement mappings but there are a few packaging constraints.

I'll loop in Kim (partner ops) for the entitlement/billing details and Priyom (integration) for the tech/evidence checklist. Proposed next steps:

- Kim: confirm minimum SKU mappings and whether Private Offer needs a single-entitlement SKU or a bundle mapping.
- Priyom: provide a checklist for VPC/KMS/SOC2 evidence + a small runbook template we can attach.
- Ben/Anita: 30-min sync Thurs 11/25 10:30am PT to walk through the flow and agree on DocuSign timeline.

I've attached our current private offer template so your legal team can start filling pricing fields.

Cheers,

Anita —

Few concrete notes on entitlement & billing: 

- For Private Offer + co-sell we prefer a single metered SKU with additive sub-skus for connectors. Bundles are supported but make reporting trickier for co-sell attribution.
- Cross-account can be modelled via a primary SKU owned by LatticeAI + a billing flow where reseller gets an uplift credit; we can share a sample CSV mapping.
- Required metadata we need to publish: public SKU name, internal SKU code, meterId, supported regions, and a flag for co-sell eligibility.

I'll attach a sample SKU mapping CSV after this thread. Priyom — pinging you for the tech/evidence checklist so we can consolidate into the listing packet.

Kim
Head, Partner Operations — Redwood

All —

Thanks for the detail — productive thread. Quick answers and next steps before our Thurs call: 

1) Metering/Co-sell: we'll surface co-sell signal based on the primary SKU purchase. Kim will provide the sample CSV mapping by EOD tomorrow so you can map sub-skus.

2) KMS/BYOK: Redwood supports customer-owned keys in a BYOK pattern for private deployments; for hosted Private Offers we currently offer region-bound managed KMS + an opt-in BYOK route for enterprise customers. Priyom will attach the runbook template covering both flows.

3) VPC/Networking: recommended pattern is private peering with explicit egress paths documented in the runbook. We'll highlight latency implications and an ACL checklist so customers can pre-approve.

4) Evidence pack: Priyom, can you compile a short one-page runbook (VPC + KMS + logging endpoints), and please redact any internal telemetry references from SOC2 pdf before we pass to procurement. Anita/Gareth — please confirm if procurement needs a CSV of typical spend bands for PO line items; Kim will include co-sell flag fields in the sample mapping.
